name: M3 SMG

sights.note: measured on the supplied mesh after bake: rear = centre of the visible opening of the 5.7 mm fixed peep (hole x -3.8..1.9 mm, y 188.5..194.1 mm through an 8 mm leaf, z 0.1107..0.1189; seen down the 1.1 deg sight line the opening centre is 0.16 mm above the hole axis), front = centre of the 2.1 mm flat blade top (z 0.482..0.492); bore 5 cm below

note: M3 'grease gun' (first pattern: crank cocking handle on the right of the trigger housing, visible on the supplied model). .45 ACP, 30-round box, automatic only. Few in Normandy units on 6 June 1944: sandbox / later-war flag.
